title: 异步结果的代际隔离与过期结果拒绝
summary: 异步计算、渲染、扫描或保存必须携带可验证的 generation/session/epoch 身份；旧任务完成后不得覆盖更新的状态或文件。
invariants: Every async publication path has a generation/session/epoch identity.
Completion and failure callbacks verify that identity before mutating current state.
Temporary outputs are unique per operation or generation.
Cancelled/stale results are discarded before cache or canonical publication.
Reopening the same external URI does not make an old callback valid again.

provenance.note: Renderer generations, waveform cancellation, workspace epochs and MKV save callbacks.
